## Target

This site aims to meet the
[Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/)
at level AA, including its interactive apps, slides, courses and downloads.
Pages should work from narrow phone screens to large desktops, with a keyboard
alone, and in light and dark themes.

## Known issues

The site is still being built and has not yet been fully tested. Known issues
will be listed here.

## Reporting a problem

If something on this site is hard to use or doesn't work with the technology
you use, please
[open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/tgoodale/curiousstatistician/issues).
A contact form will be added soon.
